questions.question: Malachi said God's people all have one Father. What did he ask why they do to one another?
According to Malachi, how did Judah disgrace the LORD's beloved sanctuary?

answers.text: By marrying the daughter of a foreign god
By bowing down to the idol of a foreign god
By burning incense to the image of a foreign god

questions.question: Malachi said the people of Judah covered the LORD's altar with weeping and groaning. Why were they so upset?

answers.text: The LORD no longer received their offerings gladly
Their enemies had broken down the city walls
The rain had stopped falling on their fields
